set -eu
mkdir -p "$HOME/.codewire"
cat > "$HOME/.codewire/environment.sh" <<'CWEOF'
export ALPHA_KEY='plain-value'
export CONNECT_URL='postgres://u:p@h:5432/db?sslmode=disable'
export ZETA_TOKEN='it'\''s quoted'
CWEOF
cat > "$HOME/.codewire/environment.json" <<'CWJSON'
{
  "ALPHA_KEY": "plain-value",
  "CONNECT_URL": "postgres://u:p@h:5432/db?sslmode=disable",
  "ZETA_TOKEN": "it's quoted"
}
CWJSON
chmod 600 "$HOME/.codewire/environment.sh" "$HOME/.codewire/environment.json"
for rc in "$HOME/.profile" "$HOME/.bash_profile" "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.zshrc"; do
  touch "$rc"
  line='[ -f "$HOME/.codewire/environment.sh" ] && . "$HOME/.codewire/environment.sh"'
  if ! grep -Fqx "$line" "$rc"; then
    printf '\n%s\n' "$line" >> "$rc"
  fi
done
